title: Strange Mod Block
description: You need more blocks? You can download this mod - Strange Mod Block
body:
this mod - Strange Mod Blocks -  is a ~~cool~~ mod for fun!
Here's a short list of what's here (__at least what's present in the mod version 0.0.1__):
- Blocks: BlockOne (Первый Блок), Ogh, Wads.
- Ores: Yoiyioia (Йойойа).
this mod is small
also, at the world with Strange Mod Blocks generating a very stupid sttuctures! добавь фото

this mod is small, of course, but it doesn't crash (because of names like Ogh, there can't be conflicts with other mods), it's eye-hurting, and so... strange? no! maybe the textures aren't the best quality, but the essence is more important. and what is the essence? To add to the world many, Many, MANY, VERY MANY different blocks etc. and they will stand out among vanilla ones!
**This mod, unlike others, doesn't try to be like vanilla. this mod, unlike others, didn't choose the path of the most beautiful GUIs. this mod didn't choose 1024x1024 textures with various realistic dents. No, this mod chose its own path, a unique path, which might seem silly at first (which it isn't) – the path of the** **_Strange Mod Blocks_**  (_I don't know why there's such epicness and pathos here, it's just a Minecraft mod_)






**_HAVE FUN!_**
